Snowstorm: If at least half of the journey activities attempted today are not successful, you make no travel progress today.
Dust Storm: The first time you gain any amount of fatigue from a journey activity today, gain 1 additional level of fatigue.
Acid Rain: The first time you gain any amount of strife from a journey activity today, gain 1 additional level of strife.
Frigid: +2 to the DC of all journey activities today.
Hailstorm: -1 success tier to journey activities made today.
Thunderstorm: You are considered to have at least 4 strife today.
Sandstorm: You are considered to have at least 4 fatigue today.

Firestorm: Whenever someone gains multiple levels of fatigue or strife from a journey activity today, and no other characters are affected, the rest of the party also gains 1 level of fatigue or strife, respectively.
Monsoon: You gain 1 strife at the start of the day.
Gale Force Winds: You gain 1 fatigue at the start of the day.
Magical Energy Storm: All journey activity successes today become critical successes, and all failures become critical failures.
Windy: Roll 1d4 whenever you make a journey activity check today. On an odd result, subtract that from your total. On an even, add it.
Crepuscular Rays: If you substantially fail a journey activity today, it is considered a normal failure instead.
Rain: -1 to the DC of all journey activities today.
Sunny: +1 success tier to journey activities made today.
